The '''S&P/TSX 60 Index''' is a [[stock market index]] of 60 large companies listed on the [[Toronto Stock Exchange]]. Maintained by the Canadian S&P Index Committee, a unit of [[Standard & Poor's]], it currently exposes the investor to ten industry sectors. 

Combined with the S&P/TSX Completion Index it forms the [[S&P/TSX Composite Index]].

==TSX 60 Based Funds==
The [[iShares]] S&P/TSX 60 Index Fund ({{tsx2|XIU}}) and the Horizons BetaPro S&P/TSX 60 Index ETF ({{tsx2|HXT}}) are Canadian [[exchange-traded fund|exchange-traded]] [[index fund]]s that are tied to the S&P/TSX 60.
